product_metadata.title: QH Window Curtain Panels Dinosaur Pattern Blackout Curtain Panels Thermal Insulated & Light Blocking 42W x 84L inch (Set of 2 Panels)
features: MATERIAL:100% Polyester Curtain. High quality silky satin polyester blend, have a soft touch feeling.
SIZE: 42Wx84L inches each panel, totally 2 panels measures 84Wx84L inches.
SET INCLUDES: Two Curtain panels, 6 matte silver grommets per panel, Not Included: Curtain rod. Built-in metal grommets fit curtain rods up to 1.6" in diameter.

MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS: These soft and durable curtains are made by high quality digital printing technology, high performance on room darkening, thermal insulated, noise reducing, energy saving / efficiency and privacy protection.
SERVICE:Offer advices, Customer Service. Machine washable for easy care, use only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low and warm iron as needed.
